faqs.question: What are the check-in and check-out timings?
faqs.answer: Check-in begins at 2:00 PM and check-out is by 11:00 AM. Early check-in and late checkout can be requested through your guest dashboard or front desk subject to room readiness.

faqs.question: Do you have swimming pools on the property?
faqs.answer: Krishna Cottages maintains a strictly preserved peaceful nature atmosphere with a Strict No Swimming Pool Policy. We emphasize mist walks, natural spice plantation trekking, cold stream trails, and traditional Ayurvedic wellness.

faqs.question: Are vegetarian, Jain, or bespoke dietary meals available?
faqs.answer: Yes, our plantation dining kitchen offers 100% organic, locally sourced Kerala vegetarian delicacies, Jain meals prepared upon request, and tailored Ayurvedic diet options.

faqs.question: Can you arrange airport pickup and sightseeing taxis?
faqs.answer: Yes, our 24/7 concierge can arrange certified chauffeur transfers from Cochin International Airport (COK) and local sightseeing around Munnar, Rajakkad waterfalls, and tea estates.
